category.label: false ranges
category.description: A "from X to Y" span whose endpoints share no real scale.

source: tropes.fyi directory and the agent-toolkit signs-of-ai-writing mirror
notes: A plain two-point range stays unflagged, so numeric and version ranges pass. The chained form skips a span that holds a digit or a parenthesis, and skips a third `to` that opens a purpose clause, so `from 0 to 1000 to pick a victim` and `from left to right to reduce the list` stay clean. Only the marked forms and chained word spans report.
